title: Deeper/broader current reader portfolio and scratch SAB authoring review
mode: primary-source web research and plan-only update
scope: Refresh exact route boundaries for newly surfaced open-source DWG/DXF readers
Separate wrapper/application lineages from underlying parser implementations
Assess an experimental source-free SAB authoring API as an optional scratch-control source
Translate findings into non-blocking implementation-readiness guidance for the parity and 3D plans

method.kind: Read current project READMEs, documentation, status tables, issue reports, and published crate docs
method.limitations: Current repository pages and package documentation are project-authored capability/status evidence, not runtime qualification. No peer corpus or sample file was inspected. The experimental acis-core encoder only establishes a possible source for one generated SAB profile; it does not establish general ACIS compatibility, independent expected geometry, B-rep validity, or DWG/AcDs ownership. The local ODA v5.4.1 specification remains authoritative for DWG byte layout.

sources.revision: Current README/status reviewed 2026-10-18; project reports alpha.1 and an entity/object corpus measured 2026-08-30
sources.observed: The project describes an Apache-2.0 Rust DWG reader based on ODA Open Design Specification 5.4.1. It separates container/section and raw-object handling from alpha-quality entity decoding, reports 19 files total in its published version table with 525 skipped and 9 errored records, and does not provide a DWG writer. It is a separate implementation but not an independent normative source from this project because both use the same published specification.

sources.revision: Mutable main README/API reviewed 2026-10-18; no peer artifact installed or executed
sources.observed: The project documents a Rust-backed DWG reader, AC1015-only subset native DWG writer, and ezdxf-backed DXF export. Its read scope differs by AC version; the later-version native geometry route lists a limited common 2D subset and best-effort style/layer color resolution. It exposes strict export, skipped_by_type, and diagnostics as useful loss-report mechanisms.

sources.revision: Current README reviewed 2026-10-18; no peer artifact installed or executed
sources.observed: The project says DWG reads use LibreDWG via Rust FFI, DXF reads use the separate undxf crate, and output is JSON/SVG/PNG only. It is not a separate DWG codec or DWG/DXF writer route; only the undxf path can be counted as a separate DXF parser lineage.

sources.revision: docs.rs currently identifies acis-core 0.3.11; current cq-acis README reviewed 2026-10-18; no crate installed or executed
sources.observed: acis-core documents a bounded SAB/ASM reader, validated ACIS reference graph, and experimental source-free BoxSpec/SabEncoder for an Asm23200MetricBox profile. Its documentation explicitly distinguishes reference closure from B-rep validity and a specific Inventor/ASM version, and says its helper layer does not construct OCCT solids. cq-acis is an experimental selected-profile SAT/SAB reader and CadQuery/OpenCascade conversion route.

sources.revision: Stable ezdxf documentation and FreeCAD mutable main reviewed 2026-10-18; no package or application run
sources.observed: The stable ezdxf docs scope read/write to named DXF versions and separate ordinary reading, recovery, raw browsing, ACIS inspection, and limited copy/import support. FreeCAD's current importDWG source routes through a selected external converter and then the DXF importer. These are specific route capabilities, not whole-format or stock solid-semantic qualification.

assessment.planImpact: Adds a narrow optional peer route matrix and a source-free, profile-specific SAB scratch-authoring possibility at the existing composed S8 gate. Wrapper lineages, native read/write direction, exact version scope, parser versus kernel evidence, and unsupported/loss reporting remain distinct. No required validation gate or local implementation step changed.

implementationReadyChecks: Use dwg-rs only for an exact implemented container/object-boundary question; keep per-file decoded, skipped, and errored record outcomes and never treat its aggregate ratio as semantic support.
Use ezdwg only for overlapping exact read features or its explicit fail-closed/loss reporting; record its DWG writer as AC1015-only and distinguish the ezdxf-backed DXF output route.
Count uncad DWG observations under the pinned LibreDWG lineage; only its undxf DXF path can be a separate parser route, and JSON/SVG/PNG output is consumer evidence only.

At the existing composed S8 gate only, optionally generate a profile-specific SAB through a pinned acis-core encoder into scratch; independently declare expected dimensions, placement, units, topology, and analytic measures.

Prove libdxfrw source entity identity and DWG AcDs owner/key/payload closure before any detached SAT/SAB conversion. Score raw bytes, ACIS parser result, B-rep validity, kernel lineage, units/transforms, and native acceptance separately.
Keep peers and native applications out of ordinary implementation slices; if version/profile/platform is unavailable, record NOT_RUN or NOT_QUALIFIED and continue local work.
Do not download or commit external DWG/DXF/SAT/SAB examples; generated controls remain in memory or scratch and do not become new fixtures.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL; this research does not satisfy their external/platform or independent semantic evidence gates.
